# Sprint calendar

<!-- Generated by scripts/github/render-backlog.mjs. Edit scripts/github/backlog.mjs, not this page. -->

One sprint per week, Monday to Sunday, from Sprint 1 in module Week 2 (26 October 2026), so Sprint _n_ falls in module Week _n_ + 1. Each sprint is a milestone and an iteration on the **OrderPilot delivery** board. The dates assume no term break; if the academic calendar has one, the sprints after it move.

| Sprint          | Dates                     | Goal                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Sprint 01 (W2)  | 26 Oct 2026 – 1 Nov 2026  | The team's way of working, and an API that runs: ground rules, GitHub as code, the problem and the areas, the monorepo, CI, the shared contracts, the API shell and the database; owners and reviews |
| Sprint 02 (W3)  | 2 Nov 2026 – 8 Nov 2026   | Sign in, the shell, the full pipeline and area 1's base; the area bases for areas 2 to 4; the briefing call with Spectra and the project plan                                                        |
| Sprint 03 (W4)  | 9 Nov 2026 – 15 Nov 2026  | The last piece of the base (slides as code); the UI prototype across the four areas; design thinking and GRS by design; feature freeze for the proposal                                              |
| Sprint 04 (W5)  | 16 Nov 2026 – 22 Nov 2026 | Proposal presentation (25%); the release tagged v0.1-proposal                                                                                                                                        |
| Sprint 05 (W6)  | 23 Nov 2026 – 29 Nov 2026 | Owners start their core logic; preparing for the mock interview                                                                                                                                      |
| Sprint 06 (W7)  | 30 Nov 2026 – 6 Dec 2026  | Mock job interview (15%): each member explains their own code                                                                                                                                        |
| Sprint 07 (W8)  | 7 Dec 2026 – 13 Dec 2026  | AI-assisted coding: the sales pilot's Must items end to end; file import and the mapping engine; the purchase flow (phase 2) starts                                                                  |
| Sprint 08 (W9)  | 14 Dec 2026 – 20 Dec 2026 | AI-assisted coding: the AI mapping assistant; the payment gate (Should 1)                                                                                                                            |
| Sprint 09 (W10) | 21 Dec 2026 – 27 Dec 2026 | AI-assisted coding: the PI draft on the template engine (Should 2); full invoice and packing-list matching (Should 3)                                                                                |
| Sprint 10 (W11) | 28 Dec 2026 – 3 Jan 2027  | AI-assisted coding: AWB/BL and import-permit follow-ups (Should 4); email intake and drafted notifications (Should 5)                                                                                |
| Sprint 11 (W12) | 4 Jan 2027 – 10 Jan 2027  | AI-assisted coding: more matching rules (Should 6); the purchase flow end to end; feature freeze for the technical review                                                                            |
| Sprint 12 (W13) | 11 Jan 2027 – 17 Jan 2027 | Technical review (25%); the release tagged v0.2-technical-review                                                                                                                                     |
| Sprint 13 (W14) | 18 Jan 2027 – 24 Jan 2027 | Observability: tracing, metrics and dashboards                                                                                                                                                       |
| Sprint 14 (W15) | 25 Jan 2027 – 31 Jan 2027 | Clickstream analytics                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Sprint 15 (W16) | 1 Feb 2027 – 7 Feb 2027   | AI token usage and cost tracking                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Sprint 16 (W17) | 8 Feb 2027 – 14 Feb 2027  | Deployment hardening, a DAST scan (OWASP ZAP baseline) and rehearsal; feature freeze for the final                                                                                                   |
| Sprint 17 (W18) | 15 Feb 2027 – 21 Feb 2027 | Final presentation (35%); the release tagged v1.0-final                                                                                                                                              |
| Sprint 18 (W19) | 22 Feb 2027 – 28 Feb 2027 | Client check-in and handover                                                                                                                                                                         |

The stories planned for each sprint are in the [backlog](https://github.com/xiu2809xiu-rgb/orderpilot/blob/main/docs/agile/backlog.md#sprints).
